mapper.insert: insert into reservation(customer_name, movie_id, seat_number, ticket_count, reservation_status) values (#{customerName}, #{movieId}, #{seatNumber}, #{ticketCount}, #{reservationStatus})
mapper.update: update reservation set reservation_date = #{reservationDate}, seat_number = #{seatNumber}, ticket_count = #{ticketCount}, reservaton_status = #{reservationStatus} where movie_id = #{movieId}
mapper.select: select r.reservation_id, r.customer_name, m.movie_id, m.movie_title, m.movie_genre, r.reservation_date, r.seat_number, r.ticket_count, r.reservation_status, m.ticket_price, m.ticket_price * r.ticket_count AS total_price from reservation r inner join movie m on m.movie_id = r.movie_id
